learning_objective: 🎯 Get ready to use multiplication and division to manage a busy dairy farm, calculate milk production, and understand money!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Cows give us milk in different amounts! If one cow gives 15 liters a day, we can multiply to find out how much milk 10 cows give. Math helps us track every drop!
Animals need healthy food to grow. We use division to share a large sack of grain equally among all the cows so everyone gets enough to eat.
When the farmer sells milk, they earn money! We use large numbers to calculate the total money earned and subtract the cost of cow feed to find the final profit.

fun_activity.title: 🥛 My Kitchen Dairy
fun_activity.instructions: Find a 1-liter water bottle or milk jug at home. Guess how many small cups of water it takes to fill it completely, and then test it out!

quick_recap: ⭐ Multiplication helps us quickly add up the milk from many cows.
⭐ Division helps us share animal feed equally.
⭐ Profit is the money we keep after paying for all the farm supplies!
